common.name: Name
common.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.boundaryBody: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, copy the error ID and send it to your administrator.
errors.AUTH_INACTIVE: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.AUTH_THROTTLED: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: PIN locked after too many attempts. Ask an administrator to reset it.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: No PIN is set for this account.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.UPLOAD_INVALID: The file is not a valid image (JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB).
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: At least one active super admin is required.
errors.SELF_DEACTIVATE: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.IN_USE: This record is used elsewhere. Deactivate it instead of deleting.
errors.DEFAULT_REQUIRED: The default record cannot be deleted. Make another one the default first.
errors.CATEGORY_CYCLE: A category cannot be placed under itself or one of its own sub-categories.
errors.CODE_DUPLICATE: This code is already in use.
errors.VARIANT_DUPLICATE: A variant with the same position, size, finish and features already exists.
errors.SKU_DUPLICATE: This SKU is already used by another variant.
errors.BARCODE_DUPLICATE: This barcode is already used by another variant.
errors.FITMENT_DUPLICATE: This vehicle fitment is already recorded for the variant.
errors.PRODUCT_INCOMPLETE: The product is not ready to publish. Add an active variant and fill the required custom fields.
errors.MATRIX_TOO_LARGE: That would create {{combinations}} variants. The limit is {{max}}. Choose fewer options.
errors.IMAGE_LIMIT: Up to {{max}} images are allowed here.
errors.PRICING_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change prices.
errors.PRICE_NEGATIVE: That change would make a price negative.
errors.NO_MATCH: No variants match, so nothing would change.
errors.MIN_PRICE_ABOVE_RETAIL: The minimum price cannot be higher than the retail price.
errors.BUNDLE_NOT_ENABLED: Turn on “Is a bundle” and save before adding components.
errors.NESTED_BUNDLE: Bundles cannot be nested. A bundle cannot be a component of another bundle.
errors.BUNDLE_HAS_ITEMS: Remove the bundle components before turning bundle off.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: The file could not be read. Use the CSV or XLSX template.
errors.IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: The file still has errors. Fix them and check again.
errors.IMPORT_HEADERS_INVALID: The column headings do not match the template.
errors.IMPORT_NOT_FOUND: This check has expired. Check the file again.
errors.IMPORT_ROW_FAILED: A row could not be saved, so nothing was imported.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: The file has too many rows. The limit is {{max_rows}}.
errors.LABEL_LIMIT: Too many labels ({{requested}}). The limit is {{max}} per print.
errors.LABEL_NO_BARCODE: {{sku}} has no barcode. Turn on “Create missing barcodes” or add one.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This document is no longer in a state where that can be done. Reload and check its status.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough stock for {{sku}}: {{available}} available, {{requested}} needed.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This adjustment is over the approval limit. Send it for approval instead.
errors.EMPTY_RECEIPT: Nothing to post. Add at least one line with a quantity.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: That date is in a closed period (locked up to {{lock_date}}).
errors.OVER_RECEIPT: More than was ordered: {{ordered}} ordered, {{already_received}} already received.
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_RECEIPT: Cannot return {{requested}}: only {{received}} came in on that receipt and {{already_returned}} already went back.
errors.SUPPLIER_INACTIVE: This supplier is inactive. Reactivate it or choose another.
errors.RECEIVED_EXCEEDS_SENT: More arrived than was sent ({{sent}} sent).
errors.BUNDLE_NO_STOCK: {{sku}} is a bundle. Bundles hold no stock of their own, so use its components.
errors.COMPANY_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Fill in the company name, address and phone in Settings first.
errors.HAS_STOCK: This product still has {{units}} in stock.
errors.DAMAGED_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED: Damaged cannot be more than received.
errors.PO_ITEM_MISMATCH: That line does not belong to this order.
errors.PO_SUPPLIER_MISMATCH: The order belongs to a different supplier.
errors.GRN_MISMATCH: That receipt is not a posted receipt from this supplier.
errors.ATTACHMENT_MISMATCH: That photo belongs to a different adjustment.
errors.NOT_ON_COUNT_LIST: That item is not on this count.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.TOTAL_MISMATCH: The total changed since you last looked. Check the cart and try again.
errors.PIN_REQUIRED: A manager PIN is needed for this.
errors.WALKIN_DUE: A walk-in customer cannot leave a due. Choose a customer or take full payment.
errors.CREDIT_LIMIT: This sale goes over the customer's credit limit.
errors.PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Add the sender number and TrxID (mobile money) or the bank name and reference (bank).
errors.DUPLICATE_TRXID: This TrxID was already used. A manager must approve using it again.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_DUE: That is more than the document still owes.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: The split adds up to more than the payment.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The account does not hold enough for this. Check its balance.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL: Someone else must approve an expense you entered.
errors.SYSTEM_CATEGORY: The system uses this category for transfer charges, so it cannot be switched off or deleted.
errors.IS_TRANSFER_FEE: This is a transfer charge. Void the transfer instead.
errors.OPENING_LOCKED: The opening balance cannot change once the account has entries. Post an adjustment instead.
errors.ACCOUNT_TYPE_LOCKED: The type of an account cannot be changed.
errors.LAST_ACCOUNT_OF_TYPE: This is the only active account for its payment method, so it cannot be switched off or deleted.
errors.ACCOUNT_HAS_OPEN_SHIFT: A cashier has an open shift on this drawer. Close the shift first.
errors.TRANSFER_FEE_CATEGORY_MISSING: The transfer charge category is missing. Add it again under expense categories.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.OVERPAYMENT: The payments add up to more than the bill.
errors.VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE: This mirror is no longer available for sale.
errors.PRICE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to change prices.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open shift.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CASH: There is not that much cash in the drawer.
errors.HAS_RETURNS: An invoice with a return cannot be voided.
errors.WINDOW_EXPIRED: The return window of {{window_days}} days has passed. A manager can still approve it.
errors.QTY_EXCEEDS_SOLD: More than was sold and not yet returned.
errors.CUSTOMER_PHONE_EXISTS: A customer with this phone number already exists.
errors.WALKIN_PROTECTED: The walk-in customer cannot be changed or deleted.
errors.VEHICLE_DUPLICATE: This customer already has a vehicle with that registration.
errors.WARRANTY_EXPIRED: This item is not under warranty.
errors.DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The discount is larger than the amount.
errors.TENDERED_TOO_LOW: The cash received is less than the amount.
errors.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Choose the account that receives this payment.

auth.resetLinkSent: If that email exists, a reset link has been sent.
auth.passwordReset: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your Orbin POS workspace.
auth.mustChangePassword: Please set a new password before continuing.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Sales, stock and finance widgets arrive in later phases. Pick up where you left off below.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: These details print on every invoice. Required: legal name, address line 1 and at least one phone.
company.logoHelp: Original file only. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Never recolored or cropped.
company.previewHelp: Live preview of the invoice header and footer built from this form. The full PDF arrives in Phase 3.
company.previewBlocked: Invoice generation is blocked until legal name, address line 1 and a phone number are filled in.

branches.title: Branches & warehouses
branches.subtitle: One branch at launch; the schema is multi-branch ready.
branches.emptyLocations: No storage locations yet. Add racks, shelves and bins so stock can be placed precisely.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Each staff member has their own login and role.
users.passwordHelp: Minimum 8 characters. The user is asked to change it on first login.
users.mustChangePassword: Require password change at next login
users.pinHelp: Used to approve discounts and price overrides at the POS.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be signed out and cannot log in.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Tick what each role may do. Super admin always has every permission.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.subtitle: Document number formats. Numbers are gap-free and generated inside the document's transaction.

appSettings.title: POS & sales rules
appSettings.subtitle: Business rules used by the server. Changing them is audited.

keys.require_customer_for_due: Require named customer for due sales
keys.void_same_day_manager_only: Managers may void same day only
keys.allow_negative_account_balance: Allow accounts to go below zero
keys.expense_approval_threshold: Expenses from this amount need approval (৳, 0 = never)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and when. Rows are append-only.
audit.empty: No audit entries for this filter.

health.title: Hosting health
health.subtitle: Checks of the cPanel environment. Everything should be green before go-live.
health.cronStale: Scheduler has not run in the last 2 minutes. Check the cron entry.
health.clearCachesConfirm: Clear and rebuild configuration, route and view caches?
health.maintenanceOnConfirm: Put the application in maintenance mode? Staff will see a maintenance page until you turn it off.
health.runMigrationsConfirm: Run pending database migrations now? Take a backup first.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every base component in every state, built only from design tokens.
gallery.emptyBody: This is a designed empty state with an action.
gallery.errorBody: This is a designed error state with a retry.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: When records exist they will appear here.

masterData.subtitle: Lists the product catalogue is built from. Inactive rows stay on old records but cannot be picked again.
masterData.lookupsSubtitle: Short pick-lists such as quality grade, glass type and colour finish. System lists cannot be deleted.
masterData.customFieldsSubtitle: Extra fields on products, variants, customers and suppliers. They appear in the editor and can show on the POS card.
masterData.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed. If it is used anywhere you will be asked to deactivate it instead.
masterData.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first one.
masterData.emptyValues: This list has no values yet.
masterData.emptyFields: No custom fields for this record type yet.
masterData.deleteListBody: The list “{{name}}” and its values will be removed. Lists in use cannot be deleted.
masterData.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.
masterData.requiredHint: A draft can be saved without it; publishing is blocked until it is filled.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Mirrors, glass and parts, with every size, side and feature as a variant.
products.newSubtitle: Start with the basics. The product is saved as a draft and goes live when you publish it.
products.searchPlaceholder: Name, code, SKU, barcode, OEM no. or vehicle
products.empty: No products yet. Add the first one or import a file.
products.variantsEmpty: No variants yet. Add one, or generate several at once with the matrix.
products.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and its variants will be removed. SKUs and barcodes stay reserved.
products.deleteVariantBody: Variant {{sku}} will be removed. Its SKU and barcode stay reserved and cannot be reused.
products.draftCreated: Draft created. Now add the variants.
products.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the SKU of new variants.
products.returnDaysHint: Leave empty to use the shop-wide return window.
products.skuHint: Leave empty to create one from the product code.
products.aliasesHint: Other barcodes that scan to this variant, separated by commas.
products.sizeLabelHint: Leave empty to build it from width and height.
products.lastCostHint: Set by purchases in a later phase.
products.pricingHint: Edit a price and save. Rows with unsaved changes are sent together.
products.pricingLocked: You can see prices but not change them. Ask an owner or manager.
products.stockHint: When stock falls to the reorder level the item is flagged for purchasing.

matrix.title: Variant matrix
matrix.subtitle: Pick the options and every combination becomes a variant. Combinations that already exist are skipped.

images.label: Label
images.drop: Drop images here or click to browse
images.rules: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB, at most {{max}} per scope.

fitment.empty: No vehicles recorded for this variant yet.
fitment.needVariant: Add a variant first, then record the vehicles it fits.
fitment.copyTitle: Copy these fitments to other variants

custom.none: No custom fields are defined yet. Add them under Settings, Master data.

review.title: Ready to publish?
review.posPreview: How it looks on the POS
review.deactivateTitle: Deactivate a product that has stock?
review.hasStock: This product still has {{units}} in stock. It will leave the POS but the stock stays on the books.

checks.requiredMissing: {{count}} required custom fields are still empty
checks.prices: Every active variant has a retail price
checks.barcode: Every active variant has a barcode

bulk.title: Bulk price change
bulk.scopeAll: Applies to every product. Use the filters first to narrow it down.
bulk.scopeFiltered: Applies to the products that match your current filters.
bulk.amountHint: Use a minus sign to lower prices, for example -5 or 10.50.

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.subtitle: Print labels on A4 sticker sheets or a 50 × 25 mm roll.
labels.queueEmpty: Search for a variant and add it here.
labels.startPosition: First free label on the sheet
labels.generateMissingHint: Variants without a barcode get one automatically.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Bring in vehicles, products and fitments from a spreadsheet. The file is checked first and nothing is saved until every row is valid.

hints.products: One variant per row. Rows with the same product code join the same product.
hints.fitments: Link variants (by SKU) to vehicle models and years.
hints.opening-stock: One row per variant and warehouse: SKU, warehouse code, quantity and unit cost. Only for variants with no stock history in that warehouse.

import.fixAndRetry: Fix these in your file and check it again. Nothing has been saved.

codes.UNKNOWN_TAX: No tax rate with this code
codes.UNKNOWN_LOOKUP: Not in the list of allowed values
codes.UNKNOWN_MAKE: No vehicle make with this name
codes.UNKNOWN_MODEL: No vehicle model with this name
codes.SKU_CONFLICT: This SKU belongs to a different product
codes.PRODUCT_MISMATCH: Product details differ from earlier rows of the same product
codes.MIN_PRICE_ABOVE_RETAIL: Minimum price is higher than retail price
codes.COST_REQUIRED: A cost above zero is needed
codes.ALREADY_STOCKED: This variant already has stock history in that warehouse
codes.BUNDLE_NO_STOCK: Bundles hold no stock of their own

stock.noLines: No lines yet. Search for a variant above and add it.
stock.deleteBody: The draft and its lines are removed. Nothing else changes.

inventory.subtitle: What is on the shelf, what is running low, and every movement behind it.
inventory.empty: No stock records yet. Receive goods or load opening stock to begin.
inventory.movementsSubtitle: Every stock posting in one list, newest first. Nothing here can be edited.
inventory.adjustmentsSubtitle: Corrections to stock, each with a reason. Big ones wait for a second person.
inventory.breakageSubtitle: Every breakage and damage, with who, which supplier and what it cost.
inventory.transfersSubtitle: Move stock between warehouses. It leaves the source when sent and arrives when received.
inventory.shortDelivery: Some units did not arrive. A draft adjustment was created at the source so you can put them back or write them off.
inventory.countsSubtitle: Count the shelves and correct the system to what is really there.
inventory.blindHint: Hide what the system expects while counting.
inventory.startHint: Start the count to freeze the list and the quantities on file.
inventory.addFound: Add an item that turned up but is not on the list
inventory.reorderSubtitle: Items at or below their reorder level. Choose a supplier and create purchase order drafts in one click.
inventory.agingSubtitle: How long the stock on the shelf has been there, counted from the newest receipts back.
inventory.valuationSubtitle: What the stock was worth at the end of a day, rebuilt from the movements.

purchasing.suppliersSubtitle: Who you buy from, and what you owe them.
purchasing.openingHint: What you owe them today. Cannot be changed later.
purchasing.balanceHint: From the ledger: receipts less returns.
purchasing.deleteSupplierBody: {{name}} will be removed. Suppliers with documents cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
purchasing.ordersSubtitle: Orders to suppliers, from draft to received.
purchasing.serverTotals: Totals are confirmed by the server when you save.
purchasing.linkCopied: Link copied. It works for 7 days.
purchasing.receiptsSubtitle: Goods that arrived, with freight, duty and other costs spread over the lines.
purchasing.paidToHint: Paid to (empty if the supplier billed it)
purchasing.landedEmpty: Add lines with a quantity and a cost to see the landed cost per unit.
purchasing.supplierOwed: Added to what we owe the supplier
purchasing.receiptPosted: Receipt posted. Stock, cost and the supplier balance are updated.
purchasing.returnsSubtitle: Goods sent back to a supplier.

integrity.title: Data integrity
integrity.subtitle: Proves that stock, costs, receipts and the supplier ledger still add up. It runs every night.
integrity.never: It has not run yet. Run it now to see the result.

checks.stock_levels_match_movements: Stock on file equals the sum of movements
checks.movement_balance_chain: Every movement's balance follows from the one before
checks.average_cost_matches_replay: Average costs match a replay of the history
checks.supplier_ledger_matches_documents: Supplier ledger matches receipts and returns
checks.payment_allocations_match: Each payment's allocated amount equals its allocation lines
checks.payment_postings_match: Every payment is in the account books and the party ledger once, in full
checks.document_paid_totals_match: Invoice and receipt paid totals equal the payments behind them

pos.searchPlaceholder: Search name, SKU, barcode, OEM number or scan a barcode ( / )
pos.noMatchBody: Try another year, or search by OEM number.
pos.outOfStockHint: Out of stock here. Check another warehouse or request a transfer.
pos.cartEmptyBody: Pick a size on a mirror, or scan a barcode.
pos.heldBody: Bills parked on this till. Resuming one brings its cart back.
pos.replaceBody: The cart on screen has items. Resuming this bill replaces them.
pos.overLimit: More than {{percent}}% off: a manager PIN will be asked.

pay.title: Payment
pay.subtitle: Add one or more payments, then complete the sale.
pay.tenderedHint: Leave empty if the exact amount was paid.
pay.overpay: The payments add up to more than the bill.
pay.walkInDue: A walk-in customer must pay in full. Choose a customer to leave a due.
pay.dueNote: {{amount}} will be recorded as due for {{name}}.
pay.creditWarn: This takes {{name}} past the credit limit of {{limit}}.
pay.creditBlock: This is over the credit limit of {{limit}}. A manager PIN is needed.
pay.notSaved: Not completed. Nothing was saved. Check the connection and retry.

err.tendered: The cash received is less than the amount.
err.bank: Enter the bank name and the reference.

pos.noCustomers: No customer found. Add one with a name and a phone.
pos.noLastInvoice: No invoice made on this till yet.

why.PIN_REQUIRED: This sale needs a manager: a price below the floor, a bigger discount than allowed, or credit past the limit.
why.DUPLICATE_TRXID: This TrxID was used before. Only a manager can allow it again.
why.PIN_INVALID: That PIN is not a manager's. Try again.
why.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a few minutes.

success.title: Sale complete
success.downloadFailed: The invoice could not be saved automatically. Use the Download button.

sales.subtitle: Every invoice, with its payments, returns and history.
sales.openPdf: Open PDF in a new tab
sales.verifyNote: The QR code on the invoice opens a public page that shows only the number, date, total and paid status.
sales.voidBody: Stock goes back, payments are reversed and the ledger is corrected. The invoice stays on record, marked VOID. This cannot be undone.

conditions.resellable: Resellable: goes back on the shelf

sales.refundEstimate: About {{amount}} comes back for these lines.
sales.refundNote: The server works out the exact refund from what was paid. Anything not paid becomes account credit.
sales.returnPending: Return {{no}} is waiting for a manager
sales.returnsSubtitle: Returns waiting for approval and the ones already posted.

customers.subtitle: Customers, their cars, invoices and what they owe.
customers.paymentsHidden: Your role cannot see the payment list. Ask a manager or the accountant.
customers.phoneHint: Mobile number, 01XXXXXXXXX. Separate several with commas.
customers.openingHint: What the customer owed at go-live.
customers.openingFixed: Fixed once saved: it is the first entry in the customer's account.

vehicle.deleteBody: Past invoices keep the vehicle they were made with.

shifts.subtitle: Open a shift with a float, close it against a count, and keep the Z-report.
shifts.openBody: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it as the opening float.
shifts.cannotOpen: You are not allowed to open a shift. Ask a manager.
shifts.floatHint: Cash already in the drawer. It can be zero.
shifts.closeBody: Count the notes and coins. Expected cash is {{expected}}.
shifts.cashPaidOut: Expenses, supplier payments and transfers out

quotations.subtitle: Offers made from the POS cart. They hold no stock.

warranty.subtitle: Claims against sold mirrors, from raised to resolved.
warranty.replaceNote: One unit of this variant leaves stock as the replacement.

ledger.pickPartyFirst: Pick a customer or supplier to begin.
ledger.statementFailed: The statement could not be made. Check the company profile is complete.

parties.subtitle: Every customer's and supplier's account, with a running balance.

ledger.writeOffTitle: Write off or discount a due
ledger.writeOffBody: The amount is taken off the oldest dues first and recorded in the ledger with your reason.
ledger.writeOffDone: The due was cleared and recorded.
ledger.adjustBody: A correction of the balance itself, such as a wrong opening balance. It is a dated ledger entry with your reason; nothing is edited.

receive.subtitle: Take a payment from a customer or pay a supplier. See which documents it settles before you post.

ledger.nothingDue: Nothing is due. The whole amount will be kept as an advance.
ledger.successSplit: {{applied}} applied to documents · {{advance}} kept as advance
ledger.receiptFailed: The receipt could not be made. Check the company profile is complete.
ledger.voidPaymentBody: Everything is put back: the invoices or receipts it settled become due again and the money leaves the account. The payment stays on record as void.

accounts.subtitle: The cash drawer, mobile-money wallets and bank accounts, with what each holds now.
accounts.openingHint: The opening balance can change only while the account has no entries.
accounts.adjustBody: Book a count difference or a missed entry. It is a dated entry with your reason.

expenses.subtitle: What the business spends, with approval above the limit you set.
expenses.rejectBody: It will not touch any account.
expenses.voidBody: The money goes back to the account. The expense stays on record as void.
expenses.categoriesBody: Add, rename or switch off the categories expenses are filed under.
expenses.deleteCategoryBody: Only categories no expense uses can be deleted.

transfers.subtitle: Money moved between our own accounts. A charge is booked as an expense.
transfers.body: Money leaves one account and arrives in the other. A charge is taken from the source account.
transfers.feeHint: Optional. Booked as an expense on the source account.
transfers.voidBody: Both sides and the charge are reversed. The receiving account must still hold the money.

daybook.subtitle: Every taka in and out across the accounts, with opening and closing balances.
daybook.empty: No money moved in this period.
daybook.badRange: The end date is before the start date.

dues.subtitle: Who owes us and whom we owe, by how old the dues are.
dues.clearHint: Clear the date to remove the promise.
dues.copied: Reminder copied. Paste it into WhatsApp or SMS.
dues.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy it by hand.
dues.reminderTemplate: Dear {{name}}, your balance with {{company}} is {{amount}}. Please pay when you can. Thank you.

periodLock.title: Period lock
periodLock.subtitle: Close the books up to a date. Nothing dated on or before it can be created, changed or voided.
periodLock.lockUpTo: Lock everything up to and including
periodLock.hint: Today and later stay open. Only the owner can move the lock back.
periodLock.onlyOwnerBack: Only the owner can move the lock to an earlier date or remove it.
